binary_status: evaluation candidate; not yet bundled with the public application
excluded_features: Philips Hue via hueplusplus (use separate home-lighting adapters)
limitations: mid-scan contention is Partial and requires explicit rescan
synchronous driver IOCTLs cannot be cancelled by mutex timeout
other hardware and clean Windows remain unverified

terminal managed-owner EOF cancels queued I2C discovery before shutdown wait
